name: Hourloop Fist
description: Throw a fist that loops back to the instant before it left the shoulder and lands twice.

name: Instant Stride
description: Take a stride that seems to last longer than a heartbeat and ends before the foe reacts.

name: Delay Guard
description: Hold a guard that lets a blow arrive a moment late and meet a ward already set.

name: Interval Sense
description: Count the stretched intervals between the opponent's blows to tell which one lands next.

name: Stretched Moment
description: Stretch a moment of the target's movement until each limb seems to wade through thick air.

name: Echoing Hour
description: Land a blow and let the same moment ring again and again through the target's guard.

name: Reprise Mend
description: Reprise one moment of healing over and over on a wound of an ally or the self until it closes.

name: Sandless Bind
description: Hold the target in a single unending moment that does not run out as long as it is fed.

name: Endless Hour
description: Cast an hour that does not end over the ground so every body in it moves as through deep water.

name: Rewound Blow
description: Throw a blow and call it back a breath later to throw it again from the same place.

name: Moment Unspent
description: Cross a gap in a moment that never passes and strike before the world moves on.

name: Eternal Instant
description: streams: Infinity + Time; fold one instant into itself without limit and deliver the whole of it as one blow.

name: Unfolding Fist
description: Unfold the space before the fist so the punch reaches past the arm's length.

name: Lengthening Stride
description: Stretch the ground beneath the foot so a single step covers a wide stretch.

name: Doubled-Over Guard
description: Fold the space before the body over itself so a strike has farther to go to arrive.

name: Gap Reckoning
description: Gauge the breadth of the gaps in a crowded place and how far each stretches.

name: Expanding Lance
description: Cast a lance that unfolds more space ahead of itself as it flies and never loses reach.

name: Gapless Bind
description: Close the space around the target so there is no gap left to move into.

name: Breadth Mend
description: Spread restoring qi through a wide stretch of space to close wounds across several allies.

name: Spanning Barrage
description: Fire blows from every fold of space around the target that do not leave a safe place.

name: Boundless Burst
description: Open an expanse without bounds around the user and fill it with force that reaches every body.

name: Infinite Fold
description: Fold the space about the user over and over so no blow can reach the body and a step is a leap.

name: Rift Unbounded
description: Slip through an unbounded rift between folds of space and strike from inside the target's guard.

name: Boundless Span
description: streams: Infinity + Space; unfold space without end and carry the whole weight of the span in one blow.
